# Vaccine response

## F-001: Eight interferon-response genes rise more in the vaccine arm
**Status:** preliminary
**Claim:** IFI27, IFI44L, ISG15, MX1, RSAD2, SIGLEC1, IFIT1 and OAS1 have a larger day 28 minus day 0 increase in the vaccine arm than in placebo (padj < 0.05, BH); no other gene of the 60 tested does.
**Implications:** The vaccine induces an interferon-response signature by day 28.
**Tags:** interferon, vaccine, paired-design
